# llama-harness v0.1.0

Initial crates.io release of the Rust-native llama-harness framework for
controlled agentic workflows.

The facade has no default features. Enable `ollama`, `observability`, `evals`,
`tauri`, `programmatic`, or `mcp` explicitly as needed. All eight crates declare Rust 1.88 as their
minimum supported Rust version.

## Published crates

- `llama-harness-programmatic-sandbox` — deterministic `no_std` program
  contracts with no ambient host authority.
- `llama-harness-core` — embedded, provider-neutral agent runtime.
- `llama-harness-ollama` — direct loopback Ollama provider.
- `llama-harness-observability` — redacted local SQLite trace persistence.
- `llama-harness-tauri` — embedded Tauri helpers.
- `llama-harness-evals` — deterministic evaluation and replay contracts.
- `llama-harness-mcp` — optional, provider-neutral MCP tool integration.
- `llama-harness` — facade crate with optional `ollama`, `observability`,
  `evals`, `tauri`, `programmatic`, and `mcp` features.

This release does not publish the runtime sidecar, SDKs, CLI, Promptfoo
integration, examples, or developer console. See `docs/releasing.md` for the
separate Rust crates.io and sidecar/SDK release procedures.
